text: Vibration limits: the vibration of the foundation under the OEM dynamic loads shall not exceed the OEM limits; where the OEM gives no limit the amplitude of the top of the foundation shall not exceed a peak velocity of 2.0 mm/s at the operating frequency (project limit). The machine vibration shall be evaluated per ISO 20816-2 (zone A / B for new machines; alarm at the zone B / C boundary and trip at C / D unless the OEM sets other levels) and the foundation shall not cause a change of the zone.
